title: Show HN: Scroll through all 43252003274489856000 Rubik's Cube states
summary: An interactive web visualization tool that allows users to explore all 43 quintillion possible states of a standard 3x3x3 Rubik's Cube through a smooth scrolling interface, providing an intuitive way to understand the massive combinatorial space of the puzzle.
problem_solved: Makes the abstract concept of 43 quintillion Rubik's Cube combinations tangible and explorable through visual navigation.
why_valuable: It transforms an incomprehensible number into an interactive experience, making combinatorial mathematics accessible and engaging for puzzle enthusiasts and math learners alike.
